verdict.rationale: Buzz's own marketing says users can search conversations alongside patches, workflow runs and approvals in one place, and that agents can search six months of history. That makes search a real first-party capability, but nothing documents filtering by sender, channel or date, or admin-level access to all history, and 'six months' suggests the history may not be complete. missing for 10: documented sender/channel/date filters, full-history (not six-month) search scope, admin-scoped search across all channels, search CLI/API docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can search the full message history with filters like sender, channel, and date

citations.quote: Search the conversation, the patch, the workflow run, and the approval in one place
Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
